function tube(s,e,w,sw,ew,ww){
  let ux=e[0]-s[0],uy=e[1]-s[1];
  let vx=w[0]-e[0],vy=w[1]-e[1];
  const ul=Math.hypot(ux,uy)||1,vl=Math.hypot(vx,vy)||1;
  const ns=[-uy/ul,ux/ul],nw=[-vy/vl,vx/vl];
  let nx=ns[0]+nw[0],ny=ns[1]+nw[1];
  let nl=Math.hypot(nx,ny);
  if(nl<.01){nx=ns[0];ny=ns[1];nl=1;}
  const ne=[nx/nl,ny/nl];
  const p=(a,n,r)=>[a[0]+n[0]*r,a[1]+n[1]*r];
  const f=a=>a.join(" ");
  const sp=p(s,ns,sw),ep=p(e,ne,ew),wp=p(w,nw,ww);
  const sm=p(s,ns,-sw),em=p(e,ne,-ew),wm=p(w,nw,-ww);
  return "M"+f(sp)+
    "C"+f([sp[0]+ux*.48,sp[1]+uy*.48])+" "+
          f([ep[0]-ux*.25,ep[1]-uy*.25])+" "+f(ep)+
    "C"+f([ep[0]+vx*.32,ep[1]+vy*.32])+" "+

    "Q"+f([w[0]+vx/vl*ww,w[1]+vy/vl*ww])+" "+f(wm)+
    "C"+f([wm[0]-vx*.22,wm[1]-vy*.22])+" "+

    "C"+f([em[0]-ux*.25,em[1]-uy*.25])+" "+
          f([sm[0]+ux*.48,sm[1]+uy*.48])+" "+f(sm)+
    "Q"+f([s[0]-ux/ul*sw,s[1]-uy/ul*sw])+" "+f(sp)+"Z";
}
